title: Bandle Soldier's [Level 3] condition on 'I enter ready' is ignored — it enters ready even with 0 XP
expected: Parser emits {type:'static',effect:{type:'enter-ready'},condition:{type:'while-level',threshold:3}} for unl-151-219 (verified via parseAbilities). In packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/cost.ts, evaluateEnterReadyCondition (lines 77-129) handles only not/score-within/this-turn/opponent-controls; 'while-level' falls to default -> undefined. staticEnterReadyApplies line 70 (`!condition || evaluate(...) !== false`) treats undefined as true, so Bandle Soldier enters ready regardless of XP.
observed: At xp=0, playUnit put Bandle Soldier in base with meta.exhausted=false (rendered upright, standardMove immediately offered), while control unit Mister Root played right after entered exhausted=true. Parser emits {type:'static',effect:{type:'enter-ready'},condition:{type:'while-level',threshold:3}} but staticEnterReadyApplies/evaluateEnterReadyCondition in moves/play/cost.ts has no 'while-level' case (returns undefined -> treated as unconditional true).
